$comment: Exhaustive disposition of every public Convex read that lacks server-side authorization. Fields apply to every function in an entry; calledFunctions overrides the no-known-caller default. Public Convex functions remain network-reachable even when no enterprise product entry point admits them.

entries.whyItRemains: The removed Hiring surface and its retained backend have not yet passed the physical-deletion dependency gate.
entries.remediation: Remove the obsolete product component after dependency proof, then internalize or delete these reads; if any hiring capability is retained, add tenant-scoped authorization before re-exposure.

entries.whyItRemains: Learning insights may support a later Improve surface but are not part of the approved enterprise navigation.
entries.remediation: Require factory.read for the requested project or make the query internal until an admitted surface owns it.

entries.whyItRemains: The API-import implementation is retained for the isolated Labs workflow.
entries.remediation: Add object-derived workspace authorization and keep the caller behind Labs, or internalize until the Labs client is restored.

entries.whyItRemains: Capture ingestion and review remain available only as an experimental Labs capability.
entries.remediation: Scope reads to an authorized workspace before Labs use; internalize unused object/type lookups.

entries.whyItRemains: Code generation is isolated in Labs and retained pending capability qualification.
entries.remediation: Internalize while unused or require project scope and factory.read before any Labs client calls it.

entries.whyItRemains: The Content Pipeline route is removed, but its source and an old end-to-end diagnostic still reference this backend.
entries.remediation: Retire the diagnostic dependency, remove the obsolete component after proof, and internalize or delete the backend reads.

entries.whyItRemains: The receipt lookup supports governed-context lineage but has no current external caller.
entries.remediation: Convert to internalQuery and expose receipt data only through the already-authorized Attempt inspector.

entries.whyItRemains: These older coordinator lookups are superseded by the authorized dependency-graph projection.
entries.remediation: Internalize or remove after confirming no worker uses string-based calls; canonical clients must use getDependencyGraph.

entries.whyItRemains: Fine-grained cost events are a possible Economics backend, but Economics is not an admitted Phase 3 destination.
entries.remediation: Require factory.read for project/task/agent-derived scope before any Economics surface is admitted; internalize unused aggregations meanwhile.

entries.whyItRemains: Legacy doctor and full-E2E scripts query it as a deployment diagnostic.
entries.remediation: Require a scoped operator/service identity and return only bounded diagnostic fields, or replace it with authenticated qualification queries.

entries.whyItRemains: The deprecated Execution route redirects to WorkOrders while the legacy backend remains for dependency review.
entries.remediation: Internalize or delete after proving the WorkOrder/Attempt runtime does not depend on this legacy execution model.

entries.whyItRemains: The older execution-request queue is retained while worker/runtime dependency analysis is incomplete.
entries.remediation: Confirm the canonical execution worker uses WorkOrders/Attempts, then internalize queue reads; otherwise require signed service scope.

entries.whyItRemains: A legacy executor queue reader remains while runtime callers are being reconciled.
entries.remediation: Convert to an internal query invoked by a signed service command, or remove after proving it is superseded.

entries.whyItRemains: The older pending-executor projection remains while worker compatibility is assessed.
entries.remediation: Internalize for worker-only use or delete after confirming the persistent worker no longer consumes it.

entries.whyItRemains: The harness fleet source was consolidated into Agents, but its specialized snapshot is not consumed by the canonical destination.
entries.remediation: Either merge the useful projection into the authorized Agents backend or retire and internalize the old snapshot.

entries.whyItRemains: The old Team Pulse source redirects to Command Center; the canonical overview does not consume this projection.
entries.remediation: Authorize and merge only signals that improve Command Center; otherwise internalize the obsolete projection.

entries.whyItRemains: Repetitive-task recommendations are retained for possible governed automation improvement but are not admitted.
entries.remediation: Require project factory.read and surface through Preview Automations only after product ownership is explicit.

entries.whyItRemains: Maintenance was consolidated into Automations, but this catalog is referenced only by the old harness view.
entries.remediation: Merge qualified maintenance definitions into the authorized Automations model or internalize the duplicate catalog.

entries.whyItRemains: A legacy global feature-flag inventory remains for diagnostics; admitted UI uses scoped flag resolution elsewhere.
entries.remediation: Restrict to company administrators or internalize behind a bounded configuration diagnostic.

entries.whyItRemains: Flaky-step analysis is isolated to Labs.
entries.remediation: Add project/object authorization before Labs activation or internalize while no client exists.

entries.whyItRemains: These reads belong to the superseded GitHub integration; canonical repository authority uses GitHub App connections.
entries.remediation: Internalize or remove after confirming GitHub App connection and WorkOrder evidence paths cover all required capability.

entries.whyItRemains: Goals were consolidated into Missions; the old Goals component is retained only for safe dependency analysis.
entries.remediation: Migrate any required intent lineage to Missions, then internalize or delete the legacy Goals reads and component.

entries.whyItRemains: A permission catalog could support governance administration but has no admitted owner today.
entries.remediation: Restrict to authorized company members and return only permissions applicable to their tenant before exposure.

entries.whyItRemains: Deployment liveness/readiness probes need a narrow anonymous or service-readable contract.
entries.remediation: Review returned fields, then declare an explicit minimal anonymous health contract or require service authentication; never expose tenant data.

entries.whyItRemains: Hybrid workflows are isolated to Labs and not part of the canonical WorkOrder execution path.
entries.remediation: Add project/object authorization if Labs remains active; otherwise internalize or retire after dependency proof.

entries.whyItRemains: Meetings were removed from the enterprise product, but the old component/backend remain pending physical-deletion proof.
entries.remediation: Remove the obsolete component after dependency proof and internalize or delete the meeting reads.

entries.whyItRemains: Memory is Preview; this alternate lifecycle overview has no admitted caller.
entries.remediation: Internalize until the Preview Memory surface explicitly owns it, then enforce project factory.read.

entries.whyItRemains: The old Metrics route redirects to Preview Analytics, which uses a different authorized projection.
entries.remediation: Confirm Analytics covers the required Economics capability, then internalize or delete the duplicate metrics reads.

entries.whyItRemains: Backfill inspection supports historical data migration and one old Directory diagnostic.
entries.remediation: Move all backfill inspection to internal/admin-only maintenance functions and remove the Directory dependency.

entries.whyItRemains: An audit export may be valuable operationally, but the Live Audit route does not currently admit this endpoint.
entries.remediation: Require explicit workspace/company Audit permission, bound time range, pagination, and export audit evidence before admission.

entries.whyItRemains: Agent notification delivery is retained as a supporting capability without a canonical enterprise surface.
entries.remediation: Derive the workspace from the agent and require factory.read, or internalize for notification workers.

entries.whyItRemains: Organization/office product surfaces were removed from Mission Control Enterprise.
entries.remediation: Internalize or delete after proving Agent Fleet and Identity no longer depend on the legacy org model.

entries.whyItRemains: People and Org routes were removed; retained components still reference a subset during dependency analysis.
entries.remediation: Preserve any authorization-linked membership records, but remove legacy public projections or add strict tenant scope before reuse.

entries.whyItRemains: A historical rollout canary remains as diagnostic code.
entries.remediation: Internalize or remove the obsolete canary; use the approved health/readiness contract for deployment probes.

entries.whyItRemains: The unscoped legacy evaluator is superseded by authorized policy-envelope and task-policy paths.
entries.remediation: Internalize for server composition or remove after call-graph proof; do not re-expose without project scope.

entries.whyItRemains: Legacy QC routes were consolidated into WorkOrders and authoritative verification evidence.
entries.remediation: Map needed artifacts to authorized Attempt evidence, then internalize or delete legacy QC download/list reads.

entries.whyItRemains: QC findings are represented canonically as WorkOrder/Attempt verification evidence; old views remain unregistered.
entries.remediation: Verify canonical evidence preserves severity and remediation, then retire or internalize these legacy projections.

entries.whyItRemains: QC metrics were consolidated into Preview Analytics; the old views are not admitted.
entries.remediation: Move any needed verification trends into the authorized Analytics projection, then internalize or remove this duplicate API.

entries.whyItRemains: The legacy QC run module composes this query through the public API even though it is server-internal behavior.
entries.remediation: Convert to internalQuery and update qcRuns to internal.qcRulesets.get, then retain Policies as the product owner.

entries.whyItRemains: Legacy QC run surfaces redirect to WorkOrders/Projects/Analytics; old components are retained only for dependency proof.
entries.remediation: Confirm every useful run/evidence relationship exists in the authorized WorkOrder/Attempt model, then internalize or delete the legacy QC reads.

entries.whyItRemains: Registry identity projections may support the Live Identity directory but are not used by its canonical backend today.
entries.remediation: Merge only if needed and enforce tenant/object scope; otherwise internalize as registry implementation detail.

entries.whyItRemains: Instance inventory may support Agent Fleet, while the only current client is the consolidated legacy Directory view.
entries.remediation: Authorize by tenant/project and merge into Agents if justified; otherwise remove the legacy caller and internalize.

entries.whyItRemains: Revenue is outside the approved AI Software Factory product boundary.
entries.remediation: Remove or internalize after confirming no enterprise factory dependency.

entries.whyItRemains: Task-scoped peer review is now authorized; these broad legacy review projections have no admitted caller.
entries.remediation: Internalize or replace with explicitly project/object-scoped authorized reads if a canonical workflow needs them.

entries.whyItRemains: These broad legacy Agent Run reads are superseded by scoped Task and Attempt projections; two feed the unregistered old dashboard.
entries.remediation: Preserve canonical Attempt lineage, then internalize or delete broad legacy reads and remove the old dashboard dependency.

entries.whyItRemains: Global search was consolidated into Context Catalog and command search, but this older backend has no current caller.
entries.remediation: Internalize now; if reintroduced, require authorized workspace scope and prevent cross-company suggestion/filter leakage.

entries.whyItRemains: Demo/research-lab seed inspection is retained for local setup.
entries.remediation: Internalize or restrict to an explicit demo/admin environment; exclude from enterprise production deployment.

entries.whyItRemains: An older session bootstrap projection remains without an admitted client.
entries.remediation: Internalize or replace with the authenticated company/workspace bootstrap contract.

entries.whyItRemains: The orchestration server reads the approved Level 1 automation manifest during runtime execution.
entries.remediation: Move manifest retrieval behind the signed service-command envelope or require a scoped service identity and validate the WorkOrder project before returning artifact content.

entries.whyItRemains: The Team surface is removed and the persona lookup has no admitted owner.
entries.remediation: Internalize or delete after confirming Agent Fleet retains required persona metadata.

entries.whyItRemains: This older subscription model is superseded by watchSubscriptions and has no current caller.
entries.remediation: Migrate required state to authorized watch subscriptions, then internalize or delete these duplicate reads.

entries.whyItRemains: The Live task graph uses the authorized coordinator projection; these older relations reads have no current caller.
entries.remediation: Confirm parity with the coordinator graph, then internalize or remove; otherwise add task/project-derived authorization.

entries.whyItRemains: Routing helpers may support internal assignment, but no admitted client calls these public reads.
entries.remediation: Move routing evaluation to internalQuery and expose only an authorized, workspace-scoped decision projection if needed.

entries.whyItRemains: Telegraph was removed from enterprise navigation and product entry points.
entries.remediation: Remove the obsolete inbox after dependency proof and internalize or delete the messaging reads.

entries.whyItRemains: Test generation is an isolated Labs capability.
entries.remediation: Require project/object authorization before Labs use or internalize while unused.

entries.whyItRemains: Browser recording is isolated to Labs.
entries.remediation: Authorize by project/session owner before Labs use and bound recording metadata exposure.

entries.whyItRemains: Voice was removed from the enterprise product; the old panel remains for dependency analysis.
entries.remediation: Remove the old panel after dependency proof and internalize or delete artifact reads, preserving any artifacts required by canonical evidence.

entries.whyItRemains: The task drawer uses the newly authorized user/workspace read; the broad watcher lookup has no current caller.
entries.remediation: Internalize or derive and authorize the entity workspace before exposing watcher identities.

entries.whyItRemains: Webhook administration may support providers later, but it has no admitted enterprise owner.
entries.remediation: Require tenant administration and redact secrets/delivery payloads before any Control surface admission; internalize otherwise.

entries.whyItRemains: Workflow metrics may feed Observability/Economics later; the old component is not an admitted route.
entries.remediation: Add project scope and bounded aggregation before merging into Preview Analytics/Observability, or internalize.

entries.whyItRemains: A historical workflow-recovery canary remains for diagnostics.
entries.remediation: Internalize or remove after the Phase 3 recovery qualification supersedes it.

entries.whyItRemains: Runtime services, the workflow engine, CLI, and an old panel use these Attempt reads; canonical UI uses the authorized inspector.
entries.remediation: Split service reads behind signed scoped service commands, move server composition internal, and require operator/project scope for CLI search/status.

entries.whyItRemains: Workflow definitions are read by runtime, CLI, an old panel, and internal meta-loop composition; getById has no known caller.
entries.remediation: Use internalQuery for server composition, a signed scoped service contract for runtime, and authenticated operator access for CLI; internalize getById.
